appraisal_events.evidence: Odette, qui en avait un aussi beau, de l'exhibition duquel elle-même avait abusé, regardait, maintenant qu'elle était en «tenue de guerre» à l'imitation des dames du faubourg, avec sévérité.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator quietly exposes Odette's hypocrisy: having once flaunted her own pearls just as ostentatiously, she now severely judges the newcomers for the very display she used to indulge, having adopted faubourg severity as a pose.

appraisal_events.evidence: beaucoup de grands hôtels étaient... peuplés d'espions qui notaient les nouvelles téléphonées par Bontemps avec une indiscrétion que corrigeait seulement par bonheur le manque de sûreté de ses informations, toujours démenties par l'événement.
appraisal_events.explanation: Bontemps's indiscreetly telephoned war news is undercut by its own unreliability, quietly diminishing his credibility as an insider source even as it exposes him to eavesdropping spies.

status_effects.explanation: Her borrowed severity toward the newcomers' jewelry rings hollow given her own earlier indulgence in the same display.
His role as an insider news source is undercut by the narrator's note that his information was always eventually proven false.

ambiguities: The bare surname 'Bontemps' telephoning war/press news is not explicitly gendered; resolved here to M. Bontemps as the more plausible official source given his established governmental role, though Mme Bontemps, also active in this circle, cannot be fully ruled out.
